contract_result_reason: RUT, VIX3M, and XAU/USD have candidate source maps with synthetic schema coverage. DXY lacks an entitled exact-value retrieval, and all three ICE Brent fields lack an authorized Settlement Snapshot golden retrieval. No Macro Board may rely on the blocked fields.

source_evidence.supports: Cboe describes its downloadable volatility-index history as daily closing values updated daily.
The official daily file exposes DATE, OPEN, HIGH, LOW, and CLOSE columns.
Cboe identifies VIX3M as its constant three-month implied-volatility index for S&P 500 options.
The official daily-prices file exposes DATE and RUT columns.
Cboe defines End-of-Day index data as daily values determined at the provider-defined daily market close; it becomes historical at the next NYSE opening.
Cboe publishes index delivery and licensing routes, including end-of-day files and historical data.
The time_series contract exposes meta.symbol, meta.interval, meta.currency, meta.exchange_timezone, values[].datetime, and values[].close; close is the price at the end of the bar.
The provider identifies XAU/USD as Gold Spot / US Dollar, a Commodity quoted in USD, with a provider-defined daily main-market session.
The standard license is limited to internal use; redistribution and external display require applicable subscription rights or a separate agreement.

The Settlement Snapshot defines Settlement Price Date, Market ID, Product Name, Commodity Code, Strip, Contract Type, and Settlement Price. Settlement Price is explicitly the price at which a contract settles after the trading day ends.
The Brent contract uses symbol BRN, settles from the 19:28-19:30 London weighted-average window, and stops trading on the specified last business day.
The official expiry table exposes Contract Symbol and Last Trade Date for listed Brent contract months.
ICE defines contract code and contract-month identity and gives BRN as its Brent example.
ICE states that licensed Futures Europe data includes settlement values and is delivered through APIs and bulk file services.
ICE identifies DXY as the ICE U.S. Dollar Index and advertises daily end-of-day and historical delivery.
ICE identifies DXY (NYICDX) as the ICE U.S. Dollar Index, documents its publication hours, and establishes the official semantic identity matched by the fallback page.
Opened and parsed on 2026-07-23. The page identifies DXY U.S.: ICE Futures U.S. and U.S. Dollar Index (DXY), and exposes a Daily Historical Quotes table with Date, Open, High, Low, and Close.

MarketWatch states that index data is sourced from FactSet for informational use; the DXY page footer attributes historical and current end-of-day data to FactSet and states that quotes use local exchange time.
Longbridge documents security candlesticks with close and timestamp fields, but the observed configured source had no exact RUT, VIX3M, DXY, XAU/USD, or ICE Brent mapping.
IBKR documents daily historical-bar fields and notes that a futures close can be settlement if supplied by the exchange, which is insufficient to treat every close as settlement.

observed_provider_gaps.boundary: Keep these gaps explicit. Public or official field sources do not change the configured broker.

Observed DXY lacked market-data permission, XAU/USD history was absent, and futures bar.close does not prove official settlement. Exact public field fallbacks do not change the configured broker; never switch to IBKR unless the user configures it.

field_maps.completed_market_semantics: Cboe daily-prices RUT value, admitted only after the dated U.S. index session is complete.
field_maps.freshness: The row date must equal the selected common completed U.S. market date; otherwise stale.
field_maps.allowed_use: Read only under applicable Cboe terms for authorized internal research; do not persist or redistribute the raw file.

field_maps.freshness: The row date must equal the selected common completed U.S. market date; otherwise stale.
field_maps.allowed_use: Read only under applicable Cboe terms for authorized internal research; do not persist or redistribute the raw file.

blocker.reason: MarketWatch/FactSet visible data does not establish permitted automated retrieval. The exact IBKR NYBOT DX candidate has no market-data entitlement in the observed environment, and ICE direct access is not authorized.
blocker.required_to_close: With the user-selected default provider, obtain an authorized exact DXY closing-level response on two completed sessions, prove the response matches the ICE closing definition, and record the provider's permitted internal-use boundary.

retrieval.method: Open the HTML page, select Result Frequency Daily, and parse the visible Historical Quotes table

normalization.table_selection: Parse only the visible Historical Quotes table after confirming Result Frequency Daily; require exactly one row whose Date equals the common completed date.

field_maps.completed_market_semantics: The selected Daily Historical Quotes Close is historical/current end-of-day data attributed to FactSet in local exchange time. MarketWatch page identity and ICE DXY methodology jointly prove that the row is the ICE U.S. Dollar Index, not a futures price, ETF, or synthetic basket.
field_maps.freshness: Require the exact common completed date in the Date column and retrieve only after that local exchange date has ended; a missing or duplicate date is fail-closed.
field_maps.allowed_use: Candidate-route investigation only. Production or automated decision-support retrieval is prohibited until an entitled exact DXY closing-level route passes two completed-session golden reads and its internal-use boundary is recorded. Do not persist or redistribute raw HTML, table rows, or public raw data.

identity_guards.value: Historical and current end-of-day data provided by FACTSET
All quotes are in local exchange time

normalization.availability_gate: retrieval date in meta.exchange_timezone must be later than data_as_of

field_maps.completed_market_semantics: Provider-defined XAU/USD Commodity 1day close at the end of the provider main-market bar; the current partial date is never admitted.
field_maps.freshness: The latest completed provider day must be no more than one provider session behind the selected common market date; otherwise stale.
field_maps.allowed_use: Requires a Twelve Data entitlement that permits the user's internal research. Do not persist raw responses or externally display/redistribute values without applicable rights.

blocker.reason: ICE MFT Settlement Snapshot is the only verified source with official settlement semantics, but no ICE API/MFT entitlement is available. Generic futures close and continuous-series alternatives are insufficient.
blocker.required_to_close: Obtain ICE Futures Europe Commodities EOD/MFT access and capture two completed Settlement Snapshots with BRN settlement, market identity, strip, and official expiry rows.

retrieval.method: Authorized ICE MFT Settlement Snapshot plus official expiry table
retrieval.response_format: settlement snapshot rows plus expiry rows

normalization.front_month: For a settlement date, select the row whose Strip has the earliest official LTD greater than or equal to that date.
normalization.value: Settlement Price decimal to number; Close Price is never an alternative.

field_maps.completed_market_semantics: ICE Settlement Price, explicitly distinct from ordinary Close Price and available only after the trading day has ended.
field_maps.freshness: The Settlement Price Date must equal the selected common completed settlement date; absence is missing/source_error, never a close fallback.
field_maps.allowed_use: Production use is prohibited until an ICE Futures data license/entitlement yields two completed Settlement Snapshot golden reads. After authorization, retain only normalized fields and lineage, never the raw MFT file.

blocker.reason: The contract code must come from the same authorized official settlement row as the front-month settlement. A continuous-series label cannot supply that identity.
blocker.required_to_close: Obtain the authorized ICE Settlement Snapshot evidence required by commodities.brent_front_settlement and verify Market ID plus Strip against the official expiry table.

retrieval.method: Same selected authorized ICE settlement and expiry rows
retrieval.response_format: settlement snapshot rows plus expiry rows

normalization.contract_identity: Retain Market ID as the exact provider contract identifier.

field_maps.completed_market_semantics: Identity belongs to the same front-month row as the accepted settlement; it cannot be inferred from a continuous-series label.
field_maps.freshness: Must be present on the accepted settlement date and match the official front-month expiry selection.
field_maps.allowed_use: Production use is prohibited until the corresponding authorized ICE settlement route closes. After authorization, apply the same internal-use entitlement and no-raw-payload boundary as the settlement.

blocker.reason: Roll state requires two adjacent completed official settlement identities. No authorized ICE settlement data is available to establish them.
blocker.required_to_close: Obtain the authorized ICE Settlement Snapshot evidence required by commodities.brent_front_settlement for adjacent completed dates and derive roll state from Market ID and Strip changes.

retrieval.method: Derived from adjacent completed ICE front-month settlement identities
retrieval.endpoint: same authorized ICE settlement and expiry inputs

normalization.same_front_contract: current Market ID and Strip equal the previous completed settlement's selected front contract
normalization.front_contract_changed: current Market ID or Strip differs from the previous completed settlement's selected front contract

field_maps.completed_market_semantics: A lineage state over two completed settlement dates, never inferred from price movement or a continuous-contract adjustment.
field_maps.freshness: Both current and immediately previous completed settlement identities must be available; otherwise roll state is missing.
field_maps.allowed_use: Production use is prohibited until adjacent authorized ICE settlement identities are available. After authorization, derive internally from normalized fields and do not retain raw files.
